package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG implements repository.
type StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Create inserts answer.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer, maxAttempts *int) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	query := `
WITH stats AS (
	SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt), 0) AS last_attempt, COUNT(*) AS cnt
	FROM student_task_answer WHERE task_id=$1 AND student_id=$2 AND learning_path_item_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF($14, '')::uuid AND requirement_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF($15, '')::uuid
),
ins AS (
	INSERT INTO student_task_answer (id, student_id, task_id, filestorage_id, answer_payload, started_at, ended_at, status, attempt, created_at, updated_at, learning_path_item_id, requirement_id, frozen_task_json)
	SELECT $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, stats.last_attempt + 1, $11, $12, NULLIF($14, '')::uuid, NULLIF($15, '')::uuid, $16::jsonb
	FROM stats
	WHERE $13::int IS NULL OR stats.cnt < $13
	RETURNING attempt
)
SELECT attempt FROM ins`

	var attempt int
	err := r.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, query,
		answer.TaskID, answer.StudentID,
		answer.ID, answer.StudentID, answer.TaskID, answer.FilestorageID, answer.AnswerPayload, answer.StartedAt, answer.EndedAt, answer.Status, answer.CreatedAt, answer.UpdatedAt,
		maxAttempts, answer.LearningPathItemID, answer.RequirementID, answer.FrozenTaskJSON,
	).Scan(&attempt)
	if err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.ErrMaxAttempts
		}
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, err
	}
	answer.Attempt = attempt
	return answer, nil
}

// Update modifies answer.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error {
	_, err := r.Pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_task_answer SET filestorage_id=$1, answer_payload=$2, ended_at=$3, status=$4, attempt=$5, updated_at=$6 WHERE id=$7`,
		answer.FilestorageID, answer.AnswerPayload, answer.EndedAt, answer.Status, answer.Attempt, answer.UpdatedAt, answer.ID)
	return err
}

// GetByID returns answer by id.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	row := r.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, student_id, task_id, filestorage_id, answer_payload, started_at, ended_at, status, attempt, created_at, updated_at, COALESCE(learning_path_item_id::text, ''), COALESCE(requirement_id::text, ''), frozen_task_json FROM student_task_answer WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var a domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	if err := row.Scan(&a.ID, &a.StudentID, &a.TaskID, &a.FilestorageID, &a.AnswerPayload, &a.StartedAt, &a.EndedAt, &a.Status, &a.Attempt, &a.CreatedAt, &a.UpdatedAt, &a.LearningPathItemID, &a.RequirementID, &a.FrozenTaskJSON); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &a, nil
}

// GetActiveForTaskAndStudent fetches in progress answer.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) GetActiveForTaskAndStudent(ctx context.Context, taskID string, userID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	row := r.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, student_id, task_id, filestorage_id, answer_payload, started_at, ended_at, status, attempt, created_at, updated_at, COALESCE(learning_path_item_id::text, ''), COALESCE(requirement_id::text, ''), frozen_task_json FROM student_task_answer WHERE task_id=$1 AND student_id=$2 AND status=$3 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1`, taskID, userID, domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress)
	var a domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	if err := row.Scan(&a.ID, &a.StudentID, &a.TaskID, &a.FilestorageID, &a.AnswerPayload, &a.StartedAt, &a.EndedAt, &a.Status, &a.Attempt, &a.CreatedAt, &a.UpdatedAt, &a.LearningPathItemID, &a.RequirementID, &a.FrozenTaskJSON); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &a, nil
}

// ListForTaskAndStudent lists attempts.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) ListForTaskAndStudent(ctx context.Context, taskID string, userID string) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	rows, err := r.Pool.Query(ctx, `SELECT id, student_id, task_id, filestorage_id, answer_payload, started_at, ended_at, status, attempt, created_at, updated_at, COALESCE(learning_path_item_id::text, ''), COALESCE(requirement_id::text, ''), frozen_task_json FROM student_task_answer WHERE task_id=$1 AND student_id=$2 ORDER BY attempt`, taskID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var res []domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	for rows.Next() {
		var a domain.StudentTaskAnswer
		if err := rows.Scan(&a.ID, &a.StudentID, &a.TaskID, &a.FilestorageID, &a.AnswerPayload, &a.StartedAt, &a.EndedAt, &a.Status, &a.Attempt, &a.CreatedAt, &a.UpdatedAt, &a.LearningPathItemID, &a.RequirementID, &a.FrozenTaskJSON); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		res = append(res, a)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// CountForTaskAndStudent returns attempt count for task and user.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) CountForTaskAndStudent(ctx context.Context, taskID string, userID string) (int, error) {
	row := r.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_task_answer WHERE task_id=$1 AND student_id=$2`, taskID, userID)
	var cnt int
	if err := row.Scan(&cnt); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return cnt, nil
}

// ListForStudent lists attempts for a user across all tasks.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) ListForStudent(ctx context.Context, userID string, limit, offset int) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = 20
	}
	if limit > 200 {
		limit = 200
	}
	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}

	rows, err := r.Pool.Query(ctx, `SELECT id, student_id, task_id, filestorage_id, answer_payload, started_at, ended_at, status, attempt, created_at, updated_at, COALESCE(learning_path_item_id::text, ''), COALESCE(requirement_id::text, ''), frozen_task_json FROM student_task_answer WHERE student_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3`, userID, limit, offset)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var res []domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	for rows.Next() {
		var a domain.StudentTaskAnswer
		if err := rows.Scan(&a.ID, &a.StudentID, &a.TaskID, &a.FilestorageID, &a.AnswerPayload, &a.StartedAt, &a.EndedAt, &a.Status, &a.Attempt, &a.CreatedAt, &a.UpdatedAt, &a.LearningPathItemID, &a.RequirementID, &a.FrozenTaskJSON); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		res = append(res, a)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// CountForStudent returns attempt count for user.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) CountForStudent(ctx context.Context, userID string) (int, error) {
	row := r.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_task_answer WHERE student_id=$1`, userID)
	var cnt int
	if err := row.Scan(&cnt); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return cnt, nil
}

// GetProgressByTaskIDs returns aggregated progress for selected tasks.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) GetProgressByTaskIDs(ctx context.Context, userID string, taskIDs []string) (map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress, error) {
	result := make(map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress, len(taskIDs))
	if len(taskIDs) == 0 {
		return result, nil
	}

	rows, err := r.Pool.Query(ctx, `
WITH filtered AS (
	SELECT id, task_id, status, created_at, attempt
	FROM student_task_answer
	WHERE student_id = $1 AND task_id = ANY($2)
),
agg AS (
	SELECT
		task_id,
		BOOL_OR(status = $3) AS has_passed,
		BOOL_OR(status = $4) AS has_under_review
	FROM filtered
	GROUP BY task_id
),
latest AS (
	SELECT DISTINCT ON (task_id)
		task_id,
		id AS latest_answer_id,
		status AS latest_status
	FROM filtered
	ORDER BY task_id, created_at DESC, attempt DESC, id DESC
)
SELECT agg.task_id, agg.has_passed, agg.has_under_review, latest.latest_status, latest.latest_answer_id
FROM agg
JOIN latest USING (task_id)
`, userID, taskIDs, domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed, domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.StudentTaskProgress
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.TaskID, &item.HasPassed, &item.HasUnderReview, &item.LatestStatus, &item.LatestAnswerID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result[item.TaskID] = item
	}
	if rows.Err() != nil {
		return nil, rows.Err()
	}

	return result, nil
}

var _ repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository = (*StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG)(nil)

// ResolveAssessmentTask proves ownership and exact requirement before reading trusted frozen content.
func (r StudentTaskAnswerRepoPG) ResolveAssessmentTask(ctx context.Context, studentID, itemID, requirementID, taskID string) (*answeruc.TaskMetadata, error) {
	item, err := (&LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: r.Pool}).GetLessonItem(ctx, studentID, itemID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateLessonAssignment(item); err != nil || item.LessonRevisionID == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if item.Status == domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered || item.Status == domain.LearningPathItemCompleted {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	var requirement *domain.LessonRequirement
	for i := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		if item.FrozenRequirements[i].ID == requirementID {
			requirement = &item.FrozenRequirements[i]
			break
		}
	}
	if requirement == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if requirement.Satisfied || requirement.SourceReference.ID != taskID || (requirement.Type != "quiz_passed" && requirement.Type != "task_passed") {
		return nil, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	var content struct {
		Tasks []json.RawMessage `json:"tasks"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(item.LessonContent, &content); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var found *answeruc.TaskMetadata
	for _, raw := range content.Tasks {
		var metadata answeruc.TaskMetadata
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &metadata); err != nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if metadata.ID != taskID {
			continue
		}
		if found != nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		metadata.CompletionFactType = requirement.Type
		metadata.CompletionSourceRevisionID = requirement.SourceReference.RevisionID
		found = &metadata
	}
	if found == nil || found.LessonID != item.ReferenceID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return found, nil
}
